breakpoints.note: For the staged witness this call happens only after decoded characters have been copied out of `p_decoder` and tokenized into `sbuf`/`words[]`; unsupported punctuation is split at word boundaries, so the `word` argument here is an attacker-controlled token selected from `words[ix]`, not simply all bytes after the leading separator. That selected word is the one whose first translation emits `phonSWITCH` and whose retranslation later reaches `LookupLetter()`.

Source step. `Synthesize()` decodes the fuzzer-provided UTF-8/SSML buffer into shared `p_decoder` state. `SpeakNextClause()` later drives `TranslateClause()` by pulling characters back out of this decoder, so this is the earliest project-side materialization on the crashing path.
The staged patch fixes the bug by moving these nested fallback call sites onto independent `translator3` storage so this delete branch no longer tears down the outer translator.
